name: TabsMotion
description: An animated tab component with a sliding underline indicator that transitions smoothly between the active tabs. Designed for horizontal tab bars where motion feedback enhances the user experience.

notes: Each tab is a button with role='tab' inside a role='tablist' container.
Arrow keys navigate between tabs. Home and End jump to first and last tab.
The sliding indicator is purely decorative (aria-hidden).
Respects prefers-reduced-motion by disabling the slide animation.

tabs.description: Array of tab definitions. Each item has a unique 'key' and a 'label' (ReactNode).

activeKey.description: The key of the currently active tab (controlled).

onChange.description: Called when the user activates a different tab.

fill.description: Tab width behaviour. 'intrinsic' sizes tabs to content; 'fixed' makes all tabs equal width.

className.description: Additional CSS class names applied to the root element.

do: Use when you need animated tab transitions for a polished UI.
Keep tab labels short and clear.
Use the fill='fixed' option when tabs should share equal width.
dont: Do not use for navigation between separate pages — use HeaderNavigation instead.
Do not nest TabsMotion inside another TabsMotion.
Do not use with a very large number of tabs (more than 8) where overflow is likely.
